title: Why Does Your Voice Sound Weird on Recordings? #voice
description:
When you speak, you hear yourself two ways: through the air, and through the bones of your head. A microphone only catches the air path, so a recording is closer to the voice everyone else hears.

More on sound waves: How do headphones cancel noise with more noise? https://youtu.be/rOxQ3PFvewk

Sources
- Reinfeldt, Östli, Håkansson & Stenfelt (2010), J. Acoust. Soc. Am. 128(2): 751–762
- Stenfelt & Goode (2005), Otology & Neurotology 26(6): 1245–1261
- Pörschmann (2000), Acta Acustica united with Acustica 86(6): 1038–1045
- Holzman & Rousey (1966), J. Personality and Social Psychology 4(1): 79–86
